info.name: Vendor App API (Production - Hostinger)
info.description:
Complete production API collection for Vendor App running on Hostinger (https://knowlipop.shop).
Includes automatic dynamic registration, JWT Bearer token capture on Login & Register, full product CRUD, password reset OTP flows, seller bank onboarding, and Admin endpoints.

request.description: Registers a new seller with email or phone (both or a single identifier/email_or_phone field also supported). Automatically saves returned Bearer token into {{token}}.
Logs in the seller with email or phone (both, email only, phone only, or a single identifier/login/email_or_phone field) and password, and saves JWT Bearer token into {{token}}.
Returns current authenticated seller profile (safe seller details without password hash).
Returns full profile of the currently logged-in seller, including ID, contact, address, landmark, state, country, active products count, and linked bank account info.
